spanish: Y si no alcanzare su mano bastancia de res del rebaño, y traerá su culpa que pecó, dos tórtolas o dos hijos de paloma a Jehová, uno a expiación y uno a holocausto.
grammarChanges: Replaced 'oveja' with 'res del rebaño' because H7716 is one animal of the flock (sheep or goat), singular and not sex-specific; 'oveja' wrongly narrowed it to a female sheep.
Replaced 'pecado' with 'expiación' because H2403 here names the paired sin-offering (parallel to H5930 holocausto), and 'pecado' kept only the sense 'sin', not the offering.
